source: Facebook groups (UK grassroots), UK App Store, Google Play, homepage audits in Chrome

competitors.name: Pocket Gaffer
competitors.features: Live minutes, tells you who's next on, one-tap match report for the parents' WhatsApp, live links.
competitors.website_seo: 15-page sitemap including 5 guides (equal playing time, FA Power Play, matchday stress). Proper title, SoftwareApplication schema.
competitors.promotion: Posts guide links in Junior Grassroots Hub rather than app pitches.
competitors.threat_reason: Same pitch and same £2.99 price as yours, and already building content.

competitors.name: FairPlay Coach
competitors.features: Substitution planner, playing time tracker, live parent view. England equal playing time guidance page.
competitors.website_seo: Only 4 URLs in sitemap, but title targets 'Grassroots Football Coaching App', with SoftwareApplication and FAQ schema. Ranked 1st on Google UK for two of the four app queries I tried.
competitors.promotion: Nik Bannister posts in The Grassroots Football Group.
competitors.threat_reason: Already owns the top Google spot for the app searches you want.

competitors.name: Roll On Football
competitors.features: Balances keepers, positions and ability, buzzes at every sub, re-plans for late arrivals, tracks fairness all season.
competitors.website_seo: No website found.
competitors.promotion: Own Facebook page.
competitors.threat_reason: Closest feature set to your rotation engine, and charting at No. 53 in UK Sports while charging £4.99.

competitors.name: FairPlay FC
competitors.features: Fair playing time, timed subs, formation and lineup, goals, results, player of the match, captain rotation.
competitors.website_seo: fairplayfc.co.uk ranks on page 1 (its /fair-playing-time page), but the site showed me a bot check so I couldn't audit it. 8 App Store ratings.
competitors.promotion: Regular posts in Junior Grassroots Hub, which Facebook labels as AI content.
competitors.threat_reason: Active in the main group and ranking, but iOS only.

competitors.name: SquadSync
competitors.features: Rotation plans in seconds, parent availability with one link, live match tracking, season stats, works offline.
competitors.website_seo: No website found. 6 App Store ratings.
competitors.promotion: Facebook posts labelled AI content. Claims '250+ teams in the first 7 days' (their own number).
competitors.threat_reason: Dark green matchday UI looks very like your Dugout design.

competitors.name: Coach Meister
competitors.stores: iOS + Apple Watch; Android in open beta
competitors.features: Auto-rotate, live sub alerts, playtime tracking, match reports shared with parents ('Proof every player got fair time').
competitors.website_seo: Site is coachmeister.com (already in your 2026-10-16 DataForSEO snapshot). I didn't audit it in this pass.
competitors.promotion: Grassroots Football Soccer Coaches group (421 members): lifetime access for Android testers.
competitors.threat_reason: Already uses the parent proof angle.

competitors.name: Match Flow
competitors.features: Full-Time fixture import, availability with email and WhatsApp reminders, tournaments, graphics, game time.
competitors.website_seo: About 800 words on the homepage, no sitemap, no blog, no schema.
competitors.promotion: Replies with app links in Junior Grassroots Hub threads.
competitors.threat_reason: On both stores, but invisible in search.

competitors.name: FTACT
competitors.features: Live match clock, goals, assists, subs, cards, saves, tactics board, parents and players can follow.
competitors.website_seo: No website found. 29 App Store ratings (4.6).
competitors.promotion: The only app I saw real users recommend unprompted, and the developer replies in person.
competitors.threat_reason: Wins on word of mouth, not on search.

competitors.name: SubTime
competitors.features: Sub timer and rotation (OTDSoft Inc.).
competitors.website_seo: Not audited. Store listings and site ranked in the top 3 for two of my four Google UK searches.
competitors.promotion: None seen in UK groups.
competitors.threat_reason: Established listing that owns 'substitution app' searches.

competitors.name: GAFFER
competitors.features: Drag-and-drop lineups, results and stats, tactics board 5v5 to 11v11, training planner, works offline.
competitors.website_seo: About 200 words, no page title, no description, no sitemap.
competitors.promotion: Daniel Heald posts in county groups.
competitors.threat_reason: Cheap, but has almost no web presence.

competitors.name: STATZO
competitors.features: Goals, assists, clean sheets, minutes and ratings for players, parents and managers.
competitors.website_seo: Site is statzoapp.com (already in your 2026-10-16 snapshot). 21 App Store ratings (4.8).
competitors.promotion: Lloyd Skull drops links in app recommendation threads.
competitors.threat_reason: Stats tracker, not a game time engine.

competitors.name: Pytch
competitors.features: Results tracking and match events.
competitors.website_seo: 43 words on the homepage, no sitemap.
competitors.promotion: Comments in Junior Grassroots Hub.
competitors.threat_reason: Thin product story online.

competitors.name: Boxlytics / TactiQ Pro
competitors.features: AI match reports, session planner, formations.
competitors.website_seo: 4-URL sitemap with 2 blog posts, schema present.
competitors.promotion: Jamie Grimshaw recruiting beta testers across North West groups.
competitors.threat_reason: Not launched yet.

competitors.name: McAuley's Matchday Mate
competitors.features: Availability, fair game time plan, sub schedule, live timer, stats, posters, match reports, multiple teams.
competitors.website_seo: No website found.
competitors.promotion: Mike McAuley's own posts.
competitors.threat_reason: Too early to judge.

competitors.name: TeamMate
competitors.features: Club registration, payments, fixtures, matchday management, communication.
competitors.website_seo: About 1,000 words, 4-URL sitemap, no blog.
competitors.promotion: Byron Ward posts it as a free Spond alternative.
competitors.threat_reason: Claims 500+ clubs and teams (their number). A different segment from yours.

competitors.name: Centre Circle
competitors.features: Squads, membership payments, safeguarding and DBS tracking.
competitors.website_seo: News and guides blogs, structured data. Says 'Trusted by 40+ County FAs'.
competitors.promotion: Paid partner post in Junior Grassroots Hub.
competitors.threat_reason: Matters for your future club tier, not today.

competitors.name: ClubRoots
competitors.features: Teams, matchdays, player records, scout portal.
competitors.website_seo: Hash-routed app (#/teams), so Google sees almost nothing.
competitors.promotion: Matt Speller posts in groups.
competitors.threat_reason: Can't rank as built.

competitors.name: FootballGPT (360tft)
competitors.features: AI session planner, plus rotation planning content.
competitors.website_seo: 619 URLs in sitemap with 36 blog posts, plus /guides and /resources. Has a page aimed at football parents.
competitors.promotion: Own page.
competitors.threat_reason: The biggest content operation found. Competes with Football Parent for coaching and parent searches.

competitors.name: The Sporting Resource calculator
competitors.features: Equal minutes by nation (FA, FAW, SFA, IFA, FAI), format, duration and squad, with a goalkeeper option.
competitors.website_seo: 136-page site plus a YouTube channel, but the calculator page's title is just the site name. It wasn't in Google's top 9 for 'equal game time calculator'.
competitors.promotion: Regular posts in Junior Grassroots Hub.
competitors.threat_reason: A good free substitute for coaches who won't pay.

competitors.name: EveryPlayer
competitors.features: Fixtures, lineups on a pitch, player development plans.
competitors.website_seo: 6-URL sitemap.
competitors.promotion: Marketing uses AI-generated players and coaches.
competitors.threat_reason: Different angle, small footprint.
